```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(openxlsx)
library(knitr)
library(here)
```


## Pull in compiled data and export annual files
```{r Pull in compiled data files, message=FALSE, include=FALSE}

#write out a csv of all the data to the main folder: 
final_data <- read.csv("../COMPASS_SynopticCB_Peeper_Data.csv")

##Separate by year for ESS-DIVE 
final_data_2022 <- subset(final_data, Year == "2022")
final_data_2023 <- subset(final_data, Year == "2023")

##Write out annual data files
write.csv(final_data_2022, "Data package/COMPASS_SynopticCB_GW-Peeper_2022.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(final_data_2023, "Data package/COMPASS_SynopticCB_GW-Peeper_2023.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

## Create flmd file
```{r create flmd}

files  = list.files("Data package")
files

files = c("COMPASS_SynopticCB_GW-Peeper_2022.csv", "COMPASS_SynopticCB_GW-Peeper_2023.csv", "dd.csv")

flmd <- data.frame(file_name = files)
flmd

flmd$file_description <- ""
flmd$standard <- ""
flmd$file_version <- ""
flmd$data_orientation <- ""
flmd$header_rows <- ""
flmd$column_or_row_name_position <- ""
flmd$notes <- ""

#add information about each line:

flmd$file_description <-  c("Depth resolved groundwater samples collected from COMPASS CB Synoptic sites in 2022",
                            "Depth resolved groundwater samples collected from COMPASS CB Synoptic sites in 2023",
                            "Data dictionary file for annual Peeper water sample analysis data files describing each column in the dataset")

flmd$data_orientation <-  c("horizontal",
                            "horizontal",
                            "horizontal")

flmd$header_rows <-   c("1",
                        "1",
                        "1")

flmd$column_or_row_name_position <- c("1",
                                      "1",
                                      "1")


#write out the flmd associated with the data:
write.csv(flmd, "Data package/flmd.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


## Create site list
```{r create site list}

##Description, Latitude, Longitude

MSM <- data.frame(
  Description = "Moneystump Swamp (MSM); one of the COMPASS-FME synoptic sites located in the Blackwater National Wildlife Refuge along the mesohaline Beaverdam Creek. This synoptic site consists of three plots: upland ('UP'; located at 38.4315N, 76.2267W), transition ('TR'; 38.4310N, 76.2277W), and wetland ('WC'; 38.4308N, 76.2286W). The site was established in June 2022. The transect spans a coastal loblolly pine forest and a mesohaline marsh dominated by Spartina and Distichlis.", 
  Latitude = "38.4310 degrees", 
  Longitude = "-76.2277 degrees")

site_list = MSM

#write out the site list associated with the data:
write.csv(site_list, "Data package/site_list.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


## Data Description - NEED TO EDIT THIS FOR PEEPER DATA
```{r data description}

#Create a text file that has the description of the data - This ideally should match the text that is in the data READ.ME 

datadescription <- "These data are measurements of depth resolved groundwater samples collected in 2022 from the COMPASS 'synoptic' site in the Chesapeake Bay region: Moneystump (MSM). This sites has space for time transects spanning coastal upland forest (UP), coastal upland forest transitioning to wetland (TR), and wetland (WC) plots. One groundwater well that extended from the top of the soil to 1 meter below the soil surface and made with slotted PVC for the entire length of that meter, were installed in each zone. In each well a sampler comprised of a solid PVC rod fitted with 13 ml volume cylindrical diffusion cells capped with 0.2 micron nylon membranes at roughly 10cm increments were installed. Each depth is isolated in the well casing with a neoprene seal. The diffusion cells were filled with DI water prior to installation then collected and subsampled and aliquoted into vials to measure groundwater ion, sulfide, and nutrient concentrations. Groundwater peeper profiles were collected roughly from at MSM during October and November of 2022 and April and June of 2023. Sampling these was discontinued after June 2023."


#write to a text file 
writeLines(datadescription, "Data package/SynopticCB_Redox_ESSDIVE_DataDescription.txt")


```


## Create Author List - Done
```{r create author list}

#Pull in the common synoptic authors list: 
authors_common <- read.csv(here("Metadata/Synoptic CB", "COMPASS_SynopticCB_common_essdive_author_list.csv"))


#create a list of the last names you want to pull 
names_we_want <- c("Wilson", "Fien", "Phillips", "Read", "Stearns", "Ward", "Bailey", "Megonigal")

#Subset the common list for the names that we want 
author_list <- authors_common %>%
  filter(last_name %in% names_we_want)

#if you need to add any other authors 
others <- data.frame(
  first_name = c("first_name1", "first_name2"), 
  last_name = c("last_name1", "last_name2"), 
  orcid = c("orcid_id1", "orcid_id2"), 
  affiliation = c("affiliation1", "affiliation2"), 
  email = c("email1", "email2")
)

#add in the other authors 
#author_list <- bind_rows(author_list, others)

#write out the author list associated with the data:
write.csv(author_list, "Data package/author_list.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
